title: Agent 对话质量 · 链路指标 / 评估覆盖 / 场景维度（P3/P4）

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE terminal_state = 'SUCCEEDED')::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS success_rate FROM platform.agent_trace_metric WHERE started_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT count(*) AS runs FROM platform.agent_trace_metric WHERE started_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT coalesce(terminal_state, 'UNKNOWN') AS 终止状态, count(*) AS 数量 FROM platform.agent_trace_metric WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Run 耗时（P50 / P95，5 分钟桶）

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch FROM started_at) / 300) * 300) AS time, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p50_ms, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p95_ms FROM platform.agent_trace_metric WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Token 用量（input / output，5 分钟桶）

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch FROM started_at) / 300) * 300) AS time, sum(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens FROM platform.agent_trace_metric WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 工具失败率 Top（按 Trace × 工具聚合）

targets.rawSql: SELECT tool_name AS 工具, sum(failed_count)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(call_count), 0) AS 失败率 FROM platform.agent_trace_tool_call WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(call_count) > 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

panels.title: 最近 Run 明细（点开 run_id 可在平台侧回放 /api/runs/{runId}/transcript）

targets.rawSql: SELECT run_id, left(tenant_id::text, 8) AS tenant, agent_id, agent_version, terminal_state, duration_ms, input_tokens, output_tokens, tool_rounds, started_at FROM platform.agent_trace_metric WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: 评估覆盖率（自动校验 / 人工抽样 · 必须并排看）
panels.description: 详细设计 §7.3：自动校验覆盖率与人工抽样覆盖率并排显示；n<30 只显示「样本不足」，不显示百分比。⚠️ 只校验 3% 时「成功率 99%」本身是误导，成功率必须与本面板并排解读。

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE auto_checked IS TRUE) AS auto_n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sampled IS TRUE) AS sampled_n FROM platform.agent_trace_metric WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)) SELECT n AS "样本数 n", CASE WHEN n >= 30 THEN auto_n::numeric / NULLIF(n, 0) END AS "自动校验覆盖率", CASE WHEN n >= 30 THEN sampled_n::numeric / NULLIF(n, 0) END AS "人工抽样覆盖率", auto_n AS "自动校验条数", sampled_n AS "人工抽样条数", CASE WHEN n < 30 THEN '样本不足（n<30，不展示百分比）' ELSE '样本充足' END AS "口径" FROM s

panels.title: L1 链路完整率（仅已自动校验的 Trace）
panels.description: ⚠️ TRACE_LINK_L1 的 PASS 只代表链路完整（有提问、有非空回答、未截断、无工具失败），**不代表答案正确性**。详细设计 §13 第 3 项（参考答案 / 题库标准解析作为判分源）未确认前，不展示「归因正确率」。n<30 不显示百分比。

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE auto_checked IS TRUE) AS checked_n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE auto_checked IS TRUE AND auto_verified IS TRUE) AS passed_n FROM platform.agent_trace_metric WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)) SELECT CASE WHEN checked_n >= 30 THEN passed_n::numeric / NULLIF(checked_n, 0) END AS l1_link_complete_rate FROM s

panels.title: 待审任务数（PENDING / IN_REVIEW）
panels.description: P2 审查队列 + P3 的 L1_GAP / SAMPLE_RANDOM 都会落到这里。队列恒为 0 时先查采集链路是否接线，而不是默认「质量没问题」。

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS pending_reviews FROM platform.review_task WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_REVIEW') AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: 审查队列明细（HIGH 优先 · 点开 trace_id 走平台回放）
panels.description: 来源口径：ALERT / ANOMALY = 告警联动；L1_GAP = 回放事实不足、机器不硬判；SAMPLE_RANDOM = 黄金基线抽样；MANUAL = 人工建单。

targets.rawSql: SELECT source AS "来源", priority AS "优先级", status AS "状态", trace_id AS "Trace", left(tenant_id::text, 8) AS "租户", run_id AS "Run", left(coalesce(note, ''), 80) AS "备注", created_at AS "创建时间" FROM platform.review_task WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY CASE priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 0 WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, created_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: 按场景拆分（自动校验 / 人工抽样覆盖率 · n<30 不展示百分比）
panels.description: 场景来自 run.input_payload.scenario 的显式标注，经白名单规范化；NULL 独立成「未标注」组，绝不从对话正文派生。覆盖率必须与样本数并排看：n<30 只显示「样本不足」，百分比置空，避免 3% 覆盖下的 99% 成功率被误读。

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(nullif(scenario, ''), '未标注') AS "场景", count(*) AS "样本数", count(*) FILTER (WHERE auto_checked IS TRUE) AS "已自动校验", count(*) FILTER (WHERE sampled IS TRUE) AS "已人工抽样", CASE WHEN count(*) >= 30 THEN round(100.0 * (count(*) FILTER (WHERE auto_checked IS TRUE)) / count(*), 1) ELSE NULL END AS "自动覆盖率%", CASE WHEN count(*) >= 30 THEN round(100.0 * (count(*) FILTER (WHERE sampled IS TRUE)) / count(*), 1) ELSE NULL END AS "抽样覆盖率%", CASE WHEN count(*) >= 30 THEN '可判读' ELSE '样本不足（n<30，不展示百分比）' END AS "口径" FROM platform.agent_trace_metric WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: 成本趋势（按小时 · 仅统计已采集成本的行）
panels.description: 详细设计 §9.1「成本趋势」：此前 13 面板未覆盖。⚠️ 分母只算 cost_amount IS NOT NULL 的行——把「未采集成本」按 0 计入会把均价算低，是最常见的静默失真。

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', started_at) AS time, sum(cost_amount) AS "成本合计", count(*) AS "样本数 n", avg(cost_amount) AS "单次均价" FROM platform.agent_trace_metric WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND cost_amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 内容质量 · 归因正确率（L2 · 仅已评级样本）
panels.description: 详细设计 §9.1「内容质量·归因正确率」。⚠️ 分母是 agent_eval_sample 里 attribution_correct 非空的行；管线已接但默认 fail-closed 不评级（无判分源 ⇒ n=0 ⇒ 显示「未启用」），绝不把「未启用」渲染成 0% 或 100%。

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (  SELECT count(*) AS graded,          count(*) FILTER (WHERE attribution_correct) AS correct   FROM platform.agent_eval_sample   WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) AND attribution_correct IS NOT NULL) SELECT graded AS "已评级样本 n",   CASE WHEN graded >= 30 THEN correct::numeric / NULLIF(graded,0) END AS "归因正确率",   correct AS "判对条数",   CASE WHEN graded = 0 THEN '未启用（无判分源 / 判定器未注册）'        WHEN graded < 30 THEN '样本不足（n<30，不展示百分比）'        ELSE '样本充足' END AS "口径" FROM s

panels.title: 内容质量 · 幻觉率（人工抽样口径）
panels.description: 详细设计 §9.1「内容质量·幻觉率」。⚠️ 分母是 sampled IS TRUE 的行（真正被人看过的样本），不是全量——用全量做分母会把「没看过」当成「没幻觉」，幻觉率被系统性低估。

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE sampled IS TRUE) AS n,          count(*) FILTER (WHERE sampled IS TRUE AND hallucination IS TRUE) AS hallucinated   FROM platform.agent_trace_metric WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)) SELECT n AS "人工抽样 n",   CASE WHEN n >= 30 THEN hallucinated::numeric / NULLIF(n,0) END AS "幻觉率",   hallucinated AS "幻觉条数",   CASE WHEN n = 0 THEN '未抽样（无人工标注）'        WHEN n < 30 THEN '样本不足（n<30，不展示百分比）'        ELSE '样本充足' END AS "口径" FROM s
